evals.prompt: We've already discussed tagging in NOTES-DISCUSSION.md. Turn it into a spec and save it to docs/specs/tags.md.
expectations: docs/specs/tags.md is written with the sections Problem Statement, Solution, User Stories, Implementation Decisions, Testing Decisions and Out of Scope

User stories are numbered in the form 'As a <actor>, I want <feature>, so that <benefit>' and cover the discussed decisions: at most 10 tags, the tag field (not #word in the body), sidebar counts, AND filtering, and tags disappearing with their last note
The agent synthesises the discussion without first interviewing the user with new questions about the feature
Implementation Decisions contain no specific file paths or code snippets
Out of Scope lists the deferred items from the discussion (colours, renaming, sharing, sync)

evals.prompt: Turn the rate-limiting discussion in DISCUSSION.md into a spec at docs/specs/rate-limit.md.
expectations: docs/specs/rate-limit.md is written with the sections Problem Statement, Solution, User Stories, Implementation Decisions, Testing Decisions and Out of Scope

Implementation Decisions carry the discussed decisions: per API key, 120 requests per minute sliding window, /health exempt, HTTP 429 with Retry-After in seconds and the rate_limited error body, in-memory counts
Testing Decisions say to test external behaviour through the HTTP interface (with a fake clock) rather than the window's internals
Implementation Decisions contain no specific file paths or code snippets
The agent does not interview the user with new questions before writing the spec
